[1] It is named after Roberto Vittori, an Italian astronaut who flew on multiple missions to the International Space Station.
[2] Roberto Vittori (born 15 October 1964 in Viterbo) is an Italian air force officer and an ESA astronaut.
[3] A night launch and the 20th mission for "Discovery", it marked the first time a Space Shuttle mission had a female pilot, Eileen Collins, the first EVAs for both a UK born astronaut Michael Foale and a US astronaut of African heritage Bernard A. Harris, Jr. and it also carried out the successful deployment and retrieval of the Spartan-204 platform, along with the scheduled rendezvous and flyaround
[4] Colin Michael Foale, CBE (born 6 January 1957) is a British-American astrophysicist and former NASA astronaut.
